title: Inspect and extend: Connect, report status, and retry carefully
objective: Use the real implementation in `src/connection.ts` to demonstrate and safely improve socket lifecycle, connection snapshots, exponential delay, max retry, and manual disconnect.
problem: A dropped connection is like a phone call that needs a retry schedule. Follow states and timers, then see how a manual disconnect stops retries. Your implementation or debugging result must remain consistent with the source architecture.
requirements: Read `src/connection.ts` and the related project files: src/connection.ts; src/data.ts; test/connection.test.ts.
Add or improve a focused behavior related to socket lifecycle, connection snapshots, exponential delay, max retry, and manual disconnect.
Add a meaningful unit test or, when platform tooling is unavailable, document a reproducible manual check.
Update documentation to identify local, simulated, external, and missing behavior accurately.
constraints: Do not claim or implement as complete a capability outside this boundary: Retry logic does not add TLS, pairing, or authentication to the relay.
Do not add credentials, personal records, real funds, or unsafe public network exposure.
Keep the change within the existing project architecture and name any new dependencies.
expected_behavior: A dropped connection is like a phone call that needs a retry schedule. Follow states and timers, then see how a manual disconnect stops retries.
acceptance_criteria: The implementation change is traceable to `src/connection.ts`.
Normal and failure/edge cases are described and tested.
The test outcome and environment are recorded honestly.
README or source comments correctly state remaining limitations.
hints: Read the caller and the closest existing test before editing.
Separate a pure rule test from any UI, device, provider, or network test.
